description: This file contains the implementation of the LeaseBasedQueueBalancer class, which manages queue balancing in a distributed Orleans cluster using leasing mechanisms. It handles lease acquisition, renewal, and responsibility updates among silos to achieve balanced queue distribution in scalable streaming scenarios.

classes.name: LeaseBasedQueueBalancer
classes.description: A distributed queue balancer that uses leasing to manage responsibility for queues among silos, supporting auto-scaling and failure scenarios in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of LeaseBasedQueueBalancer using dependency injection and options.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the balancer with the queue mapper, setting up lease maintenance and acquisition timers.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the balancer, releasing all leases and stopping timers.

methods.name: GetMyQueues
methods.description: Returns the list of queues currently owned by this balancer instance.
